title: Impact on Singapore of US-Imposed Restrictions on Sale of Semiconductor Products to China
what_it_is: Impact on Singapore of US-Imposed Restrictions on Sale of Semiconductor Products to China

sections.label: Semiconductor sector impact mitigation
sections.summary: Singapore's semiconductor sector could be impacted by US export controls, so Singapore mitigates risks and pursues industry strategies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: While these measures are not targeted at Singapore, our semiconductor sector could still be impacted, since semiconductor supply chains are highly complex and globalised.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Many semiconductor companies operating in Singapore have manufacturing processes and products that rely on US technology, which may be subject to export controls imposed by the US government.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: While Singapore and our companies cannot be completely sheltered from geopolitical tensions, we can mitigate the risks by ensuring that we remain a stable, trusted and well-connected location for companies to do business.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: We are also working with our companies to strengthen their business continuity plans and diversify their supply chains.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: We will also pursue the strategies we announced recently at the launch of our Electronics and Precision Engineering Industry Transformation Maps earlier this week.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: These include anchoring investments from leading global companies, doubling down on R&D investments in emerging semiconductor technologies and also deepening our talent pipeline.

sections.label: Companies relying on US technology
sections.summary: Many Singapore companies rely on US technologies, so there could be some impact, but no granular information is available.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: So, many of our companies do rely on US technologies as part of their manufacturing processes and operations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: There could thus be some impact on these companies, but we do not have granular information at this stage.

sections.label: PM Lee on trade restrictions
sections.summary: Prime Minister Lee said trade restrictions could result in less economic cooperation, interdependency, trust and a less stable world.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Prime Minister Lee, in Australia recently, said this week that these trade restrictions could result in, I quote, "less economic cooperation, less interdependency, less trust and possibly, ultimately, a less stable world" – which is a clear, negative force for Singapore.

sections.label: Industry Transformation Maps and diversification
sections.summary: The Industry Transformation Maps anchor capabilities and the ecosystem in Singapore, and free trade agreements should be diversified against future shocks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: We launched the Industry Transformation Maps which will anchor many of their capabilities here – it is not just the semiconductor companies, but the ecosystem that we are attracting to be based here in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: And as the Member mentioned earlier on, with regard to all of our free trade agreements that we have signed, we should make sure that we diversify as much as possible to prevent us from being affected by future shocks that will inevitably arise.
